$comment: Each entry is one mirrored specification. `vendorSlug` and `slug` together are the registry path: /registry/{vendorSlug}/{slug}. `license` is required and must be the licence of the source document — an entry whose licence cannot be established is not added. `specUrl` must point at the producer's own published specification.

apis.title: Stripe API
apis.description: Payments infrastructure — charges, customers, subscriptions, invoicing. Mirrored from Stripe's official OpenAPI specification.

apis.title: PayPal Orders API v2
apis.description: Create, update, and capture orders — PayPal's flagship checkout surface. Mirrored from PayPal's official REST API specifications.

apis.title: Square Connect API
apis.description: The full Square commerce surface — payments, orders, catalog, customers — in one bundled specification. Mirrored from Square's official spec.

apis.title: Mailgun API

apis.title: Intercom API v2.16

apis.title: Discord HTTP API

apis.title: Google Maps Platform APIs
apis.description: Directions, distance matrix, geocoding, places, and more. Mirrored from the official Google Maps Platform OpenAPI specification (pinned release).

excluded.reason: Official spec declares OpenAPI 3.1.0 but uses the 3.0-only `nullable` keyword 107+ times — fails the baseline gate (score 56) for genuine spec-correctness reasons. Revisit when upstream fixes it.
